answer: Rule: every new identity must import one unique outside credential, an account with 12 months of public verifiable work, locked to that identity forever. A nebula of fakes needs one scarce credential per fake, bought at about 200 POA each, so 100 fakes cost 20,000 POA before earning anything. One credential never backs two identities: a comet-fast cross-check burns any duplicate on sight, and the echo of that burn reaches every verifier. Cost is linear per fake, but real credentials are finite, so bulk buying drives the price up.
